task_name: Continental Cup - Player portrait card system
client_brief:
Eight-player card run with matched portraits and checked player identities

Continental Cup needs the eight-player release prepared from the supplied portraits and roster. The pictures come from two stadium lighting rigs; the cards come from a printer's PDF we need to make usable again.

Final handoff

 Player press card: 9 named exports. The portrait belongs to the named player. The player number is legible. The competition identity is visible.

Use the supplied approved copy and factual records. Permission restrictions in the owner's notes take precedence over inclusion in a source table.

Use the attached brand identity and the source files listed in the asset manifest. The output register defines exact filenames, pages, sizes and record bindings. Supporting previews are welcome but cannot replace those files.

brand_identity.tagline: The set every fan wants sealed
brand_identity.sector: Officially licensed sports collector cards (continental club football tournament)
brand_identity.founded_place_size: touring competition, Western Europe and North America; canonical context for the repeat-client series.
brand_identity.about: Continental Cup 2026 Collector Card Programme is the repeat client for this benchmark series. The canonical client context is touring competition, Western Europe and North America, and this commission covers phase 1: collector-card portrait finishing.
brand_identity.audience: Collectors aged 16 to 45 who buy officially licensed cup sets, know a licensed release from a fan-made one at a glance, and expect deep, saturated, high-contrast presentation worthy of a marquee tournament.
brand_identity.price_positioning: Premium licensed collector tier. Pack twelve dollars, sealed box ninety-five, featured cards trading roughly 30 to 120 dollars secondary. The treatment is deep and saturated with real floodlit blacks, one dominant player per card, type set large and confident. Never a flat, bright community-league sheet, and never a neon gaming poster.

palette.name: Pitch Deep Navy (retailer display and card field)

brand_identity.typography: A confident licensed-sport system: a strong condensed or wide display face for player names and the set masthead, paired with a clean, sturdy sans for squad numbers, position, honours line and data. Numerals must read cleanly at small card sizes.
brand_identity.voice: Bold, official and celebratory without slang. Speaks with the authority of a sanctioned tournament: it names the players, states the honours and lets the floodlit imagery carry the drama.
brand_identity.brand_assets_status: The brand files are largely lost. The studio that designed last year's card has closed, and all that survives is the flat file the printer ran, whose layout the retailers already recognise and want kept. The competition crest was never held as artwork at all: the only reference is a daylight photograph of the embroidered patch on an official's sleeve. The recovered mark and the rebuilt card layout therefore have to be reconstructed from those remnants and carried forward as the programme's working assets.
brand_identity.values: Authenticity of the licence above all. Depict the real featured players and the real competition mark faithfully, print the licensing copy exactly as supplied, and hold one premium look across print and store so the set reads as sanctioned, not imitated.

truth_constraints: Do not invent names, prices, claims, product features, locations, credentials, records, or documentary events that are absent from the approved inputs.
Do not silently replace a weak supplied asset. Use it honestly, reject it with a reason, or take only the brief's declared Stock or concept exception.
Record every omission, substitution, reconciliation, and material quality compromise in the delivery manifest.
Preserve identity, product geometry, material behavior, and documentary truth; retouching may improve presentation but may not change what the subject is.
production_requirements: Use the supplied approved copy and factual records. Do not invent claims, prices, dates, credentials or product features.
A clean preview is not a final file. Supply every named export and the separately listed editable source.
Retouching, masks, crop matrices and contact sheets support production; they do not replace the commissioned finished collateral.
source_of_truth: Approved client notes and permissions govern factual corrections. V4 output register governs commissioned output classes and sizes. Original rows are not automatically approved copy.
